  properties: {

    'click': 'doSomethingFun',
  },
  /** @type {string} */

  /**
   * @return {number}
   * @suppress {checkTypes,globalThis,visibility}
   */
  get someNumber() {
    return 5 * 7 + 2;
  },
  /**
   * @param {string} funAmount
   * @suppress {checkTypes,globalThis,visibility}
   */
  doSomethingFun: function(funAmount) {
    alert('Something ' + funAmount + ' fun!');
  },
  /**
   * @override
   * @suppress {checkTypes,globalThis,visibility}
   */
  created: function() {}
